name: audit-parallel-decomp-spec
title: Audit and harden the contract-first parallel-decomposition spec under 3x2 review escalation
description: The spec at docs/parallel-decomposition-spec.md was drafted by a multi-agent workflow and makes many concrete claims about real Lattice internals (canStartDevGuard vs getGuardFailureReason, pathMatchesPattern, resolveParallelSafety, audit-config resolution). Before it drives a build program it must pass adversarial review for code-claim accuracy, internal consistency, completeness, and prompt usability, fixing findings across rounds until clean.
